             genres, runtime, rating, "releaseDate", "libraryId", "folderName", "qualityProfileId",
             "languageProfileId", "addedById")
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::text::media_type_enum, 'released', false, '[]', $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::text::date,
             $10, $11, $12, $13, $14)
           RETURNING id
